title: Causal Inference in Natural Language Processing: Estimation, Prediction, Interpretation and Beyond

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing causal inference methods such as counterfactual data augmentation (swapping gender markers like pronouns and names) and estimating the causal effects of gender signals on outcomes.

Discussing the evaluation of spurious correlations with race using invariant risk minimization and the theoretical challenges of treating race as an intervenable variable in causal fairness frameworks.
